why: Operator site rvkeylargo.com/rv-sites (read 2026-10-30): 37 RV sites (13 oceanfront, 2 semi-oceanfront, 22 non-waterfront) but 'Please contact us for our seasonal rates' with no posted nightly rate and no booking engine (every 'Book now' leads to an inquiry form to fill in before phoning); it also states a standing '3 night minimum stay', and the home page markets long-term/winter-season (2026-27) sites. name: Blue Fin Rock Harbor Marina & RV Resort
flags: No readable rate anywhere current: only a 2023 Campendium report of $125/night and an undated blog range of $89-100; the operator says to contact it for seasonal rates.

No browser or Google Maps check run: the rate and minimum-stay failures settle it.
